# Vortex Dispatch

> Vortex Dispatch is a software engineering company in Cape Town, South Africa. We build production software using senior engineering and agent-orchestrated delivery across planning, implementation, code review, QA and release. We are not a transport, trucking, fleet-dispatch or TMS business.

Canonical site: https://vortexdispatch.co.za/
AI Engineering Pilot: https://vortexdispatch.co.za/engineering-pilot
Open-source model: https://vortexdispatch.co.za/open-source
Contact: hello@vortexdispatch.co.za
Location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
Founded: 2024

## What does Vortex Dispatch do?

Vortex Dispatch builds custom production software and helps engineering teams evaluate where AI coding agents improve software delivery without removing architecture discipline, code review, QA, security boundaries or human engineering control.

Typical work includes:
- custom software and web application development
- AI-native and agent-orchestrated software engineering
- booking systems and payment-enabled platforms
- marketplaces and staffing platforms
- compliance and document-generation products
- internal business systems, integrations and automation
- ongoing hosting, monitoring, support and iteration
- engineering pilots for teams evaluating AI coding agents

## AI Engineering Pilot

The Vortex Dispatch AI Engineering Pilot is a focused evaluation of agent-orchestrated software delivery on a client's real engineering environment.

A typical pilot uses:
- one real repository
- 3–5 genuine backlog tickets
- the client's existing CI, tests and acceptance criteria

The pilot measures:
- elapsed delivery time per ticket
- human interventions required
- agent failures and failure causes
- QA and test pass rate
- code-review findings
- model or subscription cost where measurable
- merge success
- rework required before acceptance

The objective is not to prove that AI can generate code. The objective is to determine whether a governed agent-orchestrated workflow can move real work through the client's engineering system without creating unacceptable review, QA or rework costs.

Pilot page: https://vortexdispatch.co.za/engineering-pilot

## What is VXD?

VXD is the open-source AI coding-agent orchestration project maintained by Vortex Dispatch.

Repository: https://github.com/tzone85/vortex-dispatch
License: Apache License 2.0

VXD coordinates coding-agent workflows across requirement planning, dependency-aware stories, isolated git worktrees, implementation, review, QA, recovery and delivery. It supports tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Gemini CLI and is a genuine standalone open-source developer tool.

## Open-source and private software factory

Vortex Dispatch uses an open-core model.

Public:
- VXD agent orchestration
- provider/runtime integrations
- git worktree isolation
- review and QA workflows
- dashboards, diagnostics and recovery tooling

Private:
- commercial production policies
- proprietary prompts and optimisation heuristics
- customer-specific governance and deployment controls
- cross-project learning and accumulated operational intelligence
- private software-factory systems used for commercial delivery

The public and private systems do not need feature parity. VXD is intended to remain useful open-source software without publishing every internal production technique used by Vortex Dispatch.

## Selected products built and operated by Vortex Dispatch

- Mini Suites: booking platform for a short-stay rental business
- ShiftSavvy: same-shift staffing marketplace for restaurants
- FoundersDesk: company document and compliance product
- Inkwenkwezi: CAPS study companion for Grades 8 to 12, with 747 topics and narrated mini-lessons
- SpeedReading: interactive speed-reading trainer
- Sovereign Breath: offline-first breathwork PWA

## Engagement

Vortex Dispatch works with businesses, CTOs, engineering teams and software agencies. Commercial engagements can include complete product delivery, engineering pilots, technical architecture, ongoing operation and maintenance, and agent-orchestrated engineering implementations.

Clients buy software outcomes and engineering capability. They do not need to adopt VXD or Vortex Dispatch's private factory systems.

Start at https://vortexdispatch.co.za/engineering-pilot for an engineering evaluation, use https://vortexdispatch.co.za/#contact for general software work, or email hello@vortexdispatch.co.za.
